description: This nice short 800 Meter loop trail is a great way to kill some time while waiting for the ferry. There are 2 beach access points along the trail down to the shores of Upper Arrow Lake. This trail was built by the Nakusp and Area Community Forest and is managed in conjunction with Recreation Sites and Trails BC.
directions: From Nakusp head North on Highway 23 for 48km to the Galena Bay ferry that takes you across Arrow Lake to Revelstoke. Once you are at the ferry landing, the trailhead is down by the lookout near the water. There is a kiosk with a trail map and info.
title: Galena Bay
